info.title: DKP-003 DM draft contract — proposed freeze
info.description: Task52; draft specification only, not approval. Candidate actions pending CID-07; no production classification/retention acceptance. Uppercase errors/no-store; bodies<=16KiB. No upload/content/publish/purge/hold-release. Receipt authority unavailable until BP-03 RustFS.

post.description: Authorization order: BP-01 membership; load catalog (unavailable/malformed503); missing route action gives403 for list/create/mutation or404 for detail/ACL/hold GET before lookup; missing document/no ACL ALLOW/explicit DENY404; stale revision409 only after authorization. Requires document.create. Atomically bootstrap only explicit creator catalog-authorized ACL subset. Receipt confers no inspect privilege; replay rechecks create authority. Successful command body exactly {documentId,revision}; no inspection-only facts. Replay rechecks current original-operation authority+ACL (create catalog only), never inspection. Self-revoked ACL replay404. Route action: document.create.

AclChange.description: Delta, not replacement. Entire changes key(principal.issuer,principal.subject,action) unique irrespective of operation, else422 DUPLICATE_ACL_CHANGE before transaction. No wildcard/group principal. RESTRICT caller-only REMOVE_ALLOW/ADD_DENY else422 RESTRICT_SCOPE. DELEGATE all4 with target same-tenant grant else422 TARGET_NOT_GRANTABLE and caller ceiling else403 DELEGATION_CEILING. ADD_ALLOW never clears DENY. Existing ADD/absent REMOVE no-op still revisions/audits. Preserve unrelated rules; final unique-rule count>100=>422 ACL_RULE_LIMIT atomic rollback.

CommandReceipt.description: Sole success body for every BP-02 mutation; no inspection-only facts. Replay requires current original-operation authority+ACL, create catalog only.

servers.description: Relative to the independently configured DM API or same-origin BFF deployment; paths define the boundary.
